title: Greeting Someone at the Door
situation: A visitor arrives at a friend's home and uses simple greetings before going inside.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa yimaada guriga saaxiib wuxuuna adeegsadaa salaamo fudud ka hor inta uusan gudaha gelin.
key_phrases: It is nice to see you.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Good morning.
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Good morning. How are you?
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan. Sidee tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I'm fine, thank you. How are you?
dialogue.somali: Waan fiicanahay, mahadsanid. Adiguna sidee tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: I'm well. It is nice to see you.
dialogue.somali: Waan fiicanahay. Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ku arko.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: It is nice to see you too.
dialogue.somali: Anigana waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ku arko.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Welcome. Please come in.
dialogue.somali: Soo dhowow. Fadlan gudaha soo gal.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Thank you.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Come in and sit down.
dialogue.somali: Soo gal oo fadhiiso.

title: Introducing a New Neighbor
situation: A host introduces a visitor to a new neighbor and they exchange names politely.
somali_situation: Martigeliye ayaa booqde u baraya deris cusub, waxayna si edeb leh isku weydaarsanayaan magacyo.
key_phrases: This is my new neighbor, Asha.
How do you know each other?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Come in. Let me introduce you.
dialogue.somali: Soo gal. Aan ku baro.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Thank you. Who is here?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Yaa halkan jooga?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: This is my new neighbor, Asha.
dialogue.somali: Tani waa deriskayga cusub, Asha.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Hello, Asha. My name is Omar.
dialogue.somali: Salaan, Asha. Magacaygu waa Omar.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Nice to meet you, Omar.
dialogue.somali: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ku barto, Omar.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Nice to meet you too.
dialogue.somali: Anigana waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ku barto.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: How do you know each other?
dialogue.somali: Sidee isku garanaysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Omar and I work in the same building.
dialogue.somali: Omar iyo anigu waxaan ka shaqeynaa isla dhismaha.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: That's nice. I just moved here last week.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa fiican tahay. Anigu toddobaadkii hore ayaan halkan u soo guuray.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Welcome to the neighborhood.
dialogue.somali: Ku soo dhowow xaafadda.

title: Leaving After a Visit
situation: A visitor politely says goodbye after tea and makes a loose plan to speak again soon.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa si edeb leh u macasalaamaynaya shaah kadib wuxuuna sameynayaa qorshe fudud oo mar dhow lagu wada hadlo.
key_phrases: I should leave now, but thank you for the tea.
It was lovely to see you.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I should leave now, but thank you for the tea.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waa inaan baxaa, laakiin waad ku mahadsan tahay shaaha.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: You're welcome. It was lovely to see you.
dialogue.somali: Adaa mudan. Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ku arkay.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: It was lovely to see you too.
dialogue.somali: Anigana waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ku arkay.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Are you walking home?
dialogue.somali: Guriga ma lugeynaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Yes, it is only ten minutes from here.
dialogue.somali: Haa, halkan waxay ka jirtaa toban daqiiqo oo keliya.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Good. Message me when you arrive.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican. Fariin ii soo dir markaad gaarto.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I will. Let's speak soon.
dialogue.somali: Waan soo diri doonaa. Aan mar dhow wada hadalno.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Yes, let's speak at the weekend.
dialogue.somali: Haa, aan wada hadalno dhammaadka toddobaadka.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Goodbye, and thanks again for the visit.
dialogue.somali: Nabadgelyo, mar kalena waad ku mahadsan tahay booqashada.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Goodbye. Take care.
dialogue.somali: Nabadgelyo. Is daryeel.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: You too. See you soon.
dialogue.somali: Adiguna sidaas oo kale. Mar dhow ayaan ku arki doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: See you soon.
dialogue.somali: Mar dhow ayaan ku arki doonaa.

title: Thanking a Neighbor for Help
situation: A visitor thanks a neighbor for helping with a delivery and making a difficult phone call.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa deris uga mahadcelinaya inuu ka caawiyay alaab la keenay iyo wicitaan telefoon oo adag.
key_phrases: Thank you for helping me yesterday.
It was very kind of you.
Please let me return the favor sometime.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I came to say thank you for helping me yesterday.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u imid inaan kaaga mahadceliyo caawintii shalay.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: You're welcome. I was glad to help.
dialogue.somali: Adaa mudan. Waan ku farxay inaan ku caawiyo.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: The delivery driver was speaking so fast.
dialogue.somali: Darawalkii alaabta keenayay aad buu u degdeg u hadlayay.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: I noticed. That phone call was not easy.
dialogue.somali: Waan arkay. Wicitaankaas telefoonku ma fududayn.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I really appreciate it.
dialogue.somali: Runtii waan ka mahadcelinayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: It was no trouble.
dialogue.somali: Wax dhib ah ma ahayn.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: It was very kind of you.
dialogue.somali: Aad bay naxariis kaaga ahayd.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Thank you for saying that.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad sidaas tiri.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Please let me return the favor sometime.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan ii oggolow inaan mar kuu gudo.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: That's thoughtful, but you do not have to.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa tixgelin, laakiin khasab kuguma aha.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I want to. Maybe I can help with your shopping next week.
dialogue.somali: Waan rabaa. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan toddobaadka dambe kaa caawiyo dukaamaysiga.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: That would be lovely.
dialogue.somali: Taasi way fiicnaan lahayd.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Good. I will call you before I go.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Waan ku soo wici doonaa ka hor intaanan tegin.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Thank you. That helps me too.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Taasi anigana way i caawinaysaa.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I'm happy we are neighbors.
dialogue.somali: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan deris nahay.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Me too. Come by any time.
dialogue.somali: Anigana sidoo kale. Mar kasta soo gudub.

title: Apologizing for Being Late
situation: A visitor arrives late and apologizes politely to the host.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa soo daahay wuxuuna si edeb leh uga raalli-gelinayaa martigeliyaha.
key_phrases: There was a lot of traffic.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I'm sorry I'm late.
dialogue.somali: Waan ka xumahay waan soo daahay.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: No problem. Are you all right?
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Ma fiicantahay?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Yes. There was a lot of traffic.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Taraafik badan ayaa jiray.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: I understand. Please come in.
dialogue.somali: Waan fahmay. Fadlan gudaha soo gal.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Thank you for waiting.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay sugitaanka.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: It is fine. We just started.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Hadda uun ayaan bilownay.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: It was my mistake. I left too late.
dialogue.somali: Khaladkayga ayuu ahaa. Aad baan u daahay markii aan baxay.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Don't worry. Sit down and have some tea.
dialogue.somali: Ha welwelin. Fadhiiso oo shaah cab.

title: Congratulating Someone on Good News
situation: A friend congratulates someone who has passed an exam and offers best wishes.
somali_situation: Saaxiib ayaa u hambalyeynaya qof imtixaan ka gudbay wuxuuna u dirayaa ducayn wanaagsan.
key_phrases: Best wishes for the next step.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: I heard your good news. Congratulations!
dialogue.somali: Warkaaga wanaagsan waan maqlay. Hambalyo!

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Thank you. I passed my exam.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Imtixaankaygii waan ka gudbay.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Well done. You worked very hard.
dialogue.somali: Si fiican baad u qabatay. Aad baad u dadaashay.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I was nervous, but I did it.
dialogue.somali: Waan walwalsanaa, laakiin waan sameeyay.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Congratulations on your good news.
dialogue.somali: Hambalyo warkaaga wanaagsan.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: That means a lot to me.
dialogue.somali: Taasi wax badan bay ii tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Are you going to celebrate?
dialogue.somali: Ma dabaaldegaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Yes, my family is coming tonight.
dialogue.somali: Haa, qoyskaygu caawa ayuu imanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Best wishes for the next step.
dialogue.somali: Ducadayda wanaagsan tallaabada xigta.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Thank you. I hope the next course goes well.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Waxaan rajeynayaa in koorsada xigta si fiican u socoto.

title: Inviting a Friend to Dinner
situation: A host invites a friend to dinner, explains the time and place, and asks for a reply.
somali_situation: Martigeliye ayaa saaxiib casho ugu casuumaya, waqtiga iyo meesha sharxaya, kadibna jawaab codsanaya.
key_phrases: Would you like to come to dinner at our home?
Are you available on Saturday evening?
Do I need to bring anything?
Please RSVP by Friday, so I know how much food to make.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Are you available on Saturday evening?
dialogue.somali: Ma firaaqo leedahay Sabtida fiidkii?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: I think so. Why?
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u maleynayaa haa. Maxaa jira?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Would you like to come to dinner at our home?
dialogue.somali: Ma rabtaa inaad gurigayaga casho ugu timaado?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: That sounds lovely. What time?
dialogue.somali: Taasi way fiican tahay. Saacaddee?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Please join us at seven.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan nagu soo biir toddobada.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Do I need to bring anything?
dialogue.somali: Wax ma soo qaataa?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: No, just bring yourself.
dialogue.somali: Maya, adiga oo keliya imow.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Thank you for the invite.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay casuumadda.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Please RSVP by Friday, so I know how much food to make.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan Jimcaha ka hor ii soo jawaab, si aan u ogaado inta cunto ee aan sameeyo.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: I will. I should know tomorrow.
dialogue.somali: Waan sameyn doonaa. Berri ayaan ogaan doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Great. I hope you can join us.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Waxaan rajeynayaa inaad nagu soo biiri karto.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Me too. I'll message you tomorrow.
dialogue.somali: Anigana sidoo kale. Berri ayaan fariin kuu soo diri doonaa.

title: Accepting a Wedding Invitation
situation: A guest accepts a wedding invitation, confirms attendance, asks about bringing children, and says they are looking forward to it.
somali_situation: Marti ayaa aqbalaya casuumad aroos, xaqiijinaya inuu imaanayo, weydiinaya carruur la keeni karo, wuxuuna sheegayaa inuu sugayo.
key_phrases: Thank you for the wedding invitation.
We are looking forward to it.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Thank you for the wedding invitation.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay casuumadda arooska.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: You're very welcome. Can you come?
dialogue.somali: Aad baad u mudan tahay. Ma iman kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Yes, I'd love to attend.
dialogue.somali: Haa, aad baan u jeclaan lahaa inaan ka soo qaybgalo.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Wonderful. We will be happy to see you there.
dialogue.somali: Cajiib. Waan ku farxi doonnaa inaan halkaas kugu aragno.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Can I bring my children?
dialogue.somali: Carruurtayda ma keeni karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Yes, children are welcome.
dialogue.somali: Haa, carruurtu way soo dhow yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: That's kind of you. What time should we arrive?
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa naxariis. Saacaddee ayaan nimaadnaa?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Please arrive before six.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan lixda ka hor imaada.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Should we bring anything for the family?
dialogue.somali: Qoyska wax ma u soo qaadnaa?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: No, your presence is enough.
dialogue.somali: Maya, joogitaankiinna ayaa nagu filan.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: We are looking forward to it.
dialogue.somali: Waan sugaynaa oo waan ku faraxsanahay.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: So are we. I will send the address again.
dialogue.somali: Annaguna sidaas oo kale. Cinwaanka mar kale ayaan kuu soo diri doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Thank you. I accept with pleasure.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Farxad ayaan ku aqbalayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: That makes us happy.
dialogue.somali: Taasi way naga farxinaysaa.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Please give my best wishes to the couple.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan ducadayda wanaagsan gaarsii lamaanaha.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: I will. See you at the wedding.
dialogue.somali: Waan gaarsiin doonaa. Arooska ayaan kugu arki doonaa.

title: Declining Tea Politely
somali_title: Shaah si edeb leh loo diidayo
situation: A visitor politely declines tea because they need to leave soon.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa si edeb leh u diidaya shaah sababtoo ah waa inuu dhowaan baxaa.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Would you like some tea?
dialogue.somali: Shaah ma rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Thank you for asking.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad i weydiisay.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: So, is that a yes?
dialogue.somali: Markaa, haa miyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Unfortunately, I can't stay.
dialogue.somali: Nasiib darro, ma joogi karo.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: No problem. Maybe another time.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Waxaa laga yaabaa mar kale.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Yes, maybe another time.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaa laga yaabaa mar kale.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Do you need to leave soon?
dialogue.somali: Ma u baahan tahay inaad dhowaan baxdo?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Yes, I need to leave soon.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa inaan dhowaan baxaa.

title: Speaking Politely on the Phone
somali_title: Telefoonka si edeb leh looga hadlayo
situation: A caller phones an office, introduces themselves, asks to speak to someone, leaves a message, and ends politely.
somali_situation: Qof wacaya ayaa xafiis wacaya, is baraya, qof inuu la hadlo codsanaya, fariin reebaya, kadibna si edeb leh u dhammeeya.
key_phrases: Good morning, this is Amina speaking.
May I speak to Mr. Hassan?
Could you hold for a moment?

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: Good morning, this is Amina speaking.
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan, waa Amina oo hadlaysa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Good morning. How can I help?
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan. Sideen kuu caawin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: May I speak to Mr. Hassan?
dialogue.somali: Mudane Hassan ma la hadli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Could you hold for a moment?
dialogue.somali: Cabbaar ma sugi kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: Yes, I can hold.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waan sugi karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I'm sorry, he is not available.
dialogue.somali: Waan ka xumahay, hadda lama heli karo.

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: Can I leave a message?
dialogue.somali: Fariin ma reebi karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Of course. What is the message?
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Fariintu waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: Please ask him to call me back. Thank you for your help.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan u sheeg inuu dib ii soo waco. Waad ku mahadsan tahay caawintaada.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I will. Thank you for your phone call.
dialogue.somali: Waan u sheegi doonaa. Waad ku mahadsan tahay wicitaankaaga.

title: Showing Respect to an Elder
somali_title: Qof weyn si xushmad leh loola hadlayo
situation: A young visitor greets an older neighbor respectfully, offers a seat, helps with bags, and listens before sitting down.
somali_situation: Booqde dhalinyaro ah ayaa deris weyn si xushmad leh u salaamaya, kursi siinaya, bacaha ka caawinaya, kadibna si fiican u dhageysanaya.
key_phrases: I want to show respect to an elder.
May I help you with the bags first?
Respect is also shown by listening.

dialogue.speaker: Young Visitor
dialogue.english: Good afternoon, Auntie Mary.
dialogue.somali: Galab wanaagsan, Eeddo Mary.

dialogue.speaker: Older Neighbor
dialogue.english: Good afternoon, my child. How are you?
dialogue.somali: Galab wanaagsan, ilmahaygiiyow. Sidee tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Young Visitor
dialogue.english: I am well, thank you. Please take this seat.
dialogue.somali: Waan fiicanahay, mahadsanid. Fadlan kursigan fadhiiso.

dialogue.speaker: Older Neighbor
dialogue.english: I really appreciate that.
dialogue.somali: Runtii taas waan ka mahadcelinayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Young Visitor
dialogue.english: I want to show respect to an elder.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan rabaa inaan qof weyn xushmad u muujiyo.

dialogue.speaker: Older Neighbor
dialogue.english: Respect is also shown by listening.
dialogue.somali: Xushmaddu sidoo kale waxay ka muuqataa dhageysiga.

dialogue.speaker: Young Visitor
dialogue.english: I will listen carefully.
dialogue.somali: Si fiican ayaan u dhageysan doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Older Neighbor
dialogue.english: Good. Sit with me for a few minutes.
dialogue.somali: Waa wanaagsan tahay. Dhowr daqiiqo ila fadhiiso.

dialogue.speaker: Young Visitor
dialogue.english: May I help you with the bags first?
dialogue.somali: Marka hore bacaha ma kaa caawin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Older Neighbor
dialogue.english: Yes, please put them by the door.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan albaabka agtiisa dhig.

dialogue.speaker: Young Visitor
dialogue.english: Of course. Thank you for listening to me too.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Adigana waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad i dhageysatay.

dialogue.speaker: Older Neighbor
dialogue.english: You are welcome, and thank you for your help.
dialogue.somali: Waad mudan tahay, adigana waad ku mahadsan tahay caawintaada.

title: Offering Help After Dinner
situation: A guest notices the host is tired after dinner and offers specific help without being pushy.
somali_situation: Marti ayaa arkaysa in martigeliyuhu casho kadib daalan yahay, kadibna si aan ku adkayn ayuu caawimo gaar ah u bixiyaa.
key_phrases: Can I help with the dishes?
I can clear the table first.
I do not want to be a bother.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: You look tired after dinner.
dialogue.somali: Cashada kadib waxaad u muuqataa qof daalan.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: A little, but I am fine.
dialogue.somali: Wax yar, laakiin waan fiicanahay.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Can I help with the dishes?
dialogue.somali: Suxuunta ma kaa caawin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: You are a guest. You do not have to.
dialogue.somali: Marti baad tahay. Khasab kuguma aha.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: I know, but I would like to offer help.
dialogue.somali: Waan ogahay, laakiin waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan caawimo bixiyo.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: That is kind of you.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa naxariis aad leedahay.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: I can clear the table first.
dialogue.somali: Marka hore miiska waan nadiifin karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: All right, please put the plates by the sink.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag, fadlan saxamada dhig saxanka agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Should I take out the rubbish too?
dialogue.somali: Qashinkana ma bannaanka u saaraa?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Only if you really do not mind.
dialogue.somali: Kaliya haddii aadan dhibsanayn.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: I do not mind at all.
dialogue.somali: Marnaba dhib iguma aha.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: I appreciate the offer.
dialogue.somali: Waan ka mahadcelinayaa caawimada aad bixisay.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: I do not want to be a bother.
dialogue.somali: Ma doonayo inaan culays kugu noqdo.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: You are helping, not bothering.
dialogue.somali: Waad caawinaysaa, culaysna ma tihid.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Then I will finish the table and leave the dishes soaking.
dialogue.somali: Markaa miiska ayaan dhammeystirayaa, suxuuntana biyo ayaan ku reebayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Thank you. That gives me a quiet evening.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Taasi waxay ii siinaysaa fiid deggan.
